messages:
anya: Quick policy ask: were hiring a part-time contractor-conversion who starts 11/20. There's the usual year-end shutdown (12/24-1/1). Do they accrue PTO pro-rata and are they eligible to carry over unused days if they start late in Nov?
devin: For accruals we pro-rate from start date, even for conversions. Carryover eligibility requires being on payroll 12/31. If theyre salaried by then, they can carry to next year up to cap.
anya: Theyre converting to full-time on 11/20 and will be on payroll. Managers worry about blackout rules during the shutdown and whether new hires must use PTO for shutdown days.
kai: Policy note: shutdown is a paid company holiday period for full-time employees; we don't force new hires to borrow PTO for shutdown if they were hired before shutdown. But part-time/prorated conversions are pro-rated for holiday pay.
hr-bot: PASTE: ```
Holiday shutdown: Employees on payroll on the first day of the shutdown are paid for company holiday days according to status (FTE vs part-time). PTO accruals begin pro-rata from hire date. Carryover: Must be an active employee on 12/31 to be eligible for carryover; unused PTO above cap is forfeited unless an approved exception is granted. Exceptions: People Ops may approve limited exceptions for role-critical hires or conversion edge-cases.```
anya: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) If theyre on payroll 12/31 but used no PTO yet, do we auto-apply carryover cap testing or do managers need to request exception? 2) If conversion is mid-pay-period, how do we compute holiday pay?
devin: 1) Carryover is automatic if within cap; exceptions only if they would exceed cap due to some manual grant. 2) Payroll handles mid-period conversions: holiday pay is pro-rated to working status on the shutdown start date. I'll loop payroll for the exact proration formula.
payroll-bot: FYI: payroll proration = (employee FTE on shutdown date) * (holiday hours). For conversions mid-period, we apply the conversion date to determine FTE fraction. Submit ticket if you need a manual override.
anya: Great, could someone add a short FAQ blurb for managers hiring conversions in Nov so they know to check payroll tag and carryover rules? I'll use it in offer comms.
kai: I'll add a line to the hiring runbook: "For hires/conversions within 6 weeks of year-end shutdown, verify payroll onboarding date and flag carryover eligibility in the offer checklist."
devin: Also adding a note to the manager checklist: "If hire converts to FTE after 12/31, they are not eligible for carryover this cycle."
anya: Thanks all. I'll draft the FAQ and share here. :thumbsup:
